name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: PAHO experts reviewed US measles elimination status to 13 Nov; nearly 7,500 US cases and 11 deaths since early 2025
state: PAHO experts met in closed session through 13 Nov to decide whether the US has lost the measles elimination status it has held since 2000, with a decision expected to be made public in the week of 16 Nov; nearly 7,500 US cases and 11 deaths have been reported since early 2025 (Reuters via News Tribune, 11 Nov). Canada, Spain and the UK have already lost elimination status. Infant deaths were announced in New York on 2 Nov and Wisconsin on 5 Nov (Healio, 9 Nov). Large outbreaks in high-income countries meet Watch.
for_you: Unvaccinated people, infants too young for the MMR jab and those with weak immune systems are most exposed. The NHS advises checking that children and adults have had two doses of MMR.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in high-income countries (US ~7,500 cases since 2025) and loss of elimination status = Watch

sources.title: News Tribune (Reuters) — US faces loss of measles-free status as experts meet for review
Healio — States report first measles deaths in decades ahead of PAHO meeting

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
